column1: # Source of truth for how every Rust workspace crate reaches (or intentionally does not reach)
# the Windows product. Keep one row per workspace member. The integration test fails on drift.

column6: gate
Single-writer service owns durable mutation; no UI-thread writes
Keep keys and cryptographic operations out of rendering code; external audit still gates production guarantees
Expose identity operations through typed service commands; do not describe identity roots as verified humans
Optional witness role only; durable service lifecycle and operator consent required
Owner-selected networking policy; bounded I/O and zero-network mode remain first-class
Real BLE/UWB adapter and physical-device evidence required before proximity claims
Value boundary plus storage-reward limitations and external review before production use
Real co-present hardware path and durable replay protection required
UniFFI mobile host boundary; not a Windows runtime dependency
Canonical object validation remains behind service API
One application service serializes store mutation and emits bounded events
Non-spendable content only; never extend CRDT merge semantics to spendable value
Verified ingest and durable outbox/service coordination; cross-NAT evidence required for internet beta
Current shared-key beta remains labelled; ratchet/mailbox/device fanout are later security gates
User-selected feeds and portable moderation; no paid influence over governance
Chunked local-first media with explicit bandwidth/seeding policy
Separate governance/build service; must not acquire a dependency path into wallet/value code
Offline bootstrap transport must be real before claiming no-internet recovery
Evaluation is read-only; activation always requires explicit owner approval for an exact release
Testnet/full-node mode only until consensus/value external gates are satisfied
Real peer receipts and replication-uniqueness limitation must remain visible
Peer discovery and network service; no central endpoint becomes a trust root
Personhood/Sybil research remains unresolved; UI must show evidence maturity honestly
Proves possession not unique replication; never market it as warehouse-resistant yet
External audit and multi-party policy; never expose treasury authority as ordinary client privilege
Multi-custodian ceremony and transport evidence required
Separate process from Forge/governance; external audit before real-value activation
Funded testnet fixture and cryptographic review required before production claims
Funded pool plus approved-contributor semantics; payment must never buy review or governance

Needs multi-device disruption tests before store-carry-forward UX is enabled
Only finalized canonical blocks may advance spendable state
Multi-validator network role; external audit and dynamic-set limitations remain gates
Heavy sealing belongs off the UI thread with weakest-device performance evidence
Background storage worker with bounded CPU disk and bandwidth budgets
Developer/admin CLI remains optional tooling rather than an app runtime dependency
Independent-builder evidence; one local process must not pretend to prove independence
Build manifests/capabilities stay behind Forge service boundary
Bounded IPC protocol between coordinator and isolated build runner
Spawn sandboxed worker on demand; never load Wasmtime/compiler surface into the GUI process
Legacy POSIX installer is intentionally not part of the Windows runtime
One policy engine gates privacy-sensitive routes before network work starts
Enable only mechanisms that actually exist and expose cost/privacy trade-offs
Authenticated peer binding must be proven over real channels, not inferred from TCP reachability
Quotes/service pricing only; must not create governance weight or hidden paid ranking
Replaceable opt-in relay operators; disappearance must cost convenience only
Optional anti-censorship entry path; requires real bridge operator tests
Local/private indexing only; privacy review before remote query composition
Shared bounded intake vocabulary behind the application service
Shared crawl/document types; no network authority by themselves
External content ingestion is explicit opt-in with provenance and resource limits
Only accepted/provenanced intake may become social objects
Crawl planning runs as an owner-enabled background worker with quotas
Outbound HTTPS is explicit and sandboxed/budgeted; never runs merely because the app opened
Zero-authority bounded wire contract shared by renderer and core service; no generic execute escape hatch
Exclusive per-user writer owns signing social mutation feed materialization crash recovery and bounded events
Presentation and user intent only; migrate direct store mutation and signing authority behind mini-app-service
DPAPI remains the Windows boundary; move signing/key use behind service IPC while keeping user ownership
Existing per-user verified installer path; no silent network/update behavior
Shipped setup executable owns install lifecycle across a process boundary
Move whole-workspace diagnostics out of GUI dependency graph and stream bounded results back
Remain a separate spawned process so value tests do not link into governance diagnostics
Bounded IPC framing for isolated extraction worker
Application service owns worker lifecycle; extractor never receives identity or wallet secrets
Optional replaceable edge-provider role; no provider is required for identity or ownership
Funded escrow/counterparty required; keep payment separate from reputation/governance authority
Migration inventory only until a real post-quantum transition is activated
Only engagement-proven attestations; never turn commercial reviews into personhood or governance weight
Needs a network-wide eligibility snapshot/testnet before user-facing claims
Treasury payout bridge remains audit-gated and multi-party
Consume bounded wallet standing/capability over IPC rather than linking value into social/search core
Route only to transports that are actually available and owner-enabled
Untrusted document extraction stays isolated and resource-bounded
Incremental local index with measured weak-device memory/latency budgets
Transparent explainable ranking with user-selectable policy; paid placement never masquerades as organic rank
Owner-controlled seeding/replication budgets; no compelled replication
Network-formation economics are not ordinary per-client authority; testnet/review first
Long-running research simulator; expose reports/imports if useful, not as production runtime logic
Funded settlement path; accepted work/payment must not grant governance power
Provider/service accounting moves behind service boundary; UI displays signed receipts and redemption state
Unified local query API becomes the UI entry point for search
Federated query composition with explicit providers and local ranking policy
Requires live peer federation and bounded authenticated transport
Needs multi-holder evidence; never claim single-node diagnostics prove fraud resistance
Verify against canonical ledger view; running-chain gate applies
Multi-peer dedup flooding requires real linked-peer tests and bounded resource policy
